purpose: Independent gold corpus for #713 high-precision near-Note matching. Each row carries two complete documents and a human-reviewed verdict (possible | distinct | unsupported); the consuming gate test asserts the real matcher agrees and measures the holdout gates.

splits.calibration: Produced by the documented mutation rules in the generator; the threshold and guards are reviewed only against these.
splits.holdout: Hand-authored literals not produced by the mutation functions (real-world misspellings, curated distinct pairs, and the named test-matrix examples). The holdout gates are measured only here.

expected.possible: Eligible pair the matcher must return as a near candidate.
expected.distinct: Eligible pair the matcher must NOT return (excluded, vetoed, case-only, or below threshold).
expected.unsupported: At least one document is ineligible, so the pair is unclassifiable and never a candidate.
